title: Contemporaneous samples (mock)
goal: Mock dataset (not empirical or user data). Read a time tree whose six samples share the same sampling time, with divergence distances supplied in months.

rubric.must: All six tips align because every root-to-tip duration is four months.
A/B and D/E are sister pairs; C shares an ancestor with D/E, and F branches at the root.
The scale identifies months, and rectangular branches preserve time differences.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the phylo/rectangular exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target shows all six samples aligned at the same rightmost position. Its branching matches the source tree: A/B are sisters; C is sister to the D/E pair; and F branches at the root. The scale and subtitle identify months, and the rectangular branch lengths show the nested timing differences. No material overlap or cropping is visible.

items.evidence: Sample A–F connect to label guides at the same horizontal position, consistent with equal four-month root-to-tip durations.
A and B join as a pair; D and E join as a pair, with C joining that clade; F branches directly from the root.
The subtitle says branch durations are in months, the scale bar is labeled “1 month,” and the rectangular branches use differing horizontal lengths while tips remain aligned.
